user.title: WAVIoT personal cabinet
user.description: Credentials for your cabinet at lk.waviot.ru. The personal API key can be copied from {api_docs} and used instead of the password.

data_description.login: The e-mail address or phone number you use to sign in.
data_description.password: Cabinet password. Not needed if an API key is given.
data_description.api_key: Personal key shown on https://lk.waviot.ru/api/. If set, no password login is performed.
data_description.element_id: Tree element (house) id. By default the element shown on the cabinet start page is used.

error.missing_credentials: A password or an API key is required.
error.two_factor: This account requires an SMS confirmation code on every login. Disable two-factor authentication in the cabinet, or provide the API key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read data from the personal cabinet.
error.no_meters: No meters with readings on the selected element.
error.invalid_element_id: The element id must be a number.

data_description.poll_interval_minutes: WAVIoT meters report about once an hour, so polling more often adds no new data.
